## Corrections — 2026-11-07 (R6.3 · REQ-XA-114, REQ-XB-222, REQ-XH-028 / AR-03)

1. **"null-equivalent" mislabels the contrast.** The efficacy contrast
   is 0 by construction: with the oracle participant the compacted view
   is never consumed, so the arms cannot change an outcome — the zero
   is structural, not an estimated null effect and not efficacy
   evidence (research/24 F10). The original text above stands verbatim.
2. **"Cumulative billed ≈ $1.41" is a rate-card estimate, not a billing
   read.** At B3 F5's rate card (e2-standard-8 + 200 GB pd-balanced +
   one in-use IPv4), the VM's life 2026-11-06T16:32Z–22:15:40Z
   (≈ 5.73 h, ≈ 18 % utilization) is ≈ $1.72; the recorded ≈ $1.41
   stops at the repairs run's end and omits the closure hour and the
   external-IPv4 charge (design/32 B3 F3). Billing was never read; the
   "$1.41" text above is retained verbatim per REQ-XB-222.
3. **The post-state `instances list` was a failed request, not an empty
   inventory.** It ran *after* `projects delete`; its output carries
   the billing-disabled WARNING, so `Listed 0 items` is not evidence of
   an empty inventory (B3 F4). The deletion evidence is the `instances
   delete` output itself plus the coordinator's read-only
   `gcloud projects describe … --format='value(lifecycleState)'` at
